decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Geotechnical survey report dated September 2014,
Arboricultural Impact Assessment dated September 2014, 
Flood Risk Assessment 14/09/14, 
Design & Access & Heritage statement, 
2222-100, 2222-101, 2222-102, 2222-103, 2222-100 (titled proposed lower ground & ground floor layouts
Construction  method statement 11/09/14
All received: 25/09/14
2222-201 Rev A, Received 30/09/14
2222-252 Rev A Received 31/10/14
 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 9:30am  to 5:30pm on Mondays to Friday and 10 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of development, an investigative trench measuring a minimum of 1m x 2m shall be dug in accordance with paragraph 7.6.3 of the Arboricultural Impact Assessment dated September 2014, details of the trench and findings, and any necessary mitigation measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
Condition : 6 - The basement hereby approved shall not be used as a separate residential dwelling. Unless approved in writing by the local planning authority.
description: Erection of lightwells to the front and rear elevations at basement level and construction of a basement under the existing building footprint to the house
